questions.q:
Assertion (A): The velocity of the moving ice increases with steepness of slope of the area and thickness of glacial ice.
Reason (R): The velocity decreases to the sides owing to lesser depth of ice and friction against the valley walls and bottom of the floor.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono kathan sahi hain. Glacier ki gati dhaal ki teekshnata aur barf ki motai ke saath badhti hai. Kinaron aur tali pe gati kam hoti hai kyunki wahan barf kam gehri hoti hai aur deewaron/tali se gharshan hota hai. Lekin (R) sirf kinaron pe gati kam hone ka kaaran batata hai, (A) ka nahi – isliye (R) sahi vyakhya nahi. Book De Martonne ke glacial erosion vichar ka bhi zikr karti hai: hime nadi ki tali ka dhaal saman na hone par darar wale kshetron me dono taraf adhiktam apardan hota hai.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Tectonic Plate) with List-II (Location):
(A) Nazca Plate (B) Scotia Plate (C) Cocos Plate (D) Juan De Fuca Plate
1. Between Caribbean and Pacific Plates 2. Between South American and Pacific Plates 3. South of South American Plate 4. Between Pacific and North American Plates
questions.exp: Nazca – South American aur Pacific plate ke beech; Scotia – South American plate ke dakshin me; Cocos – Caribbean aur Pacific ke beech; Juan de Fuca – Pacific aur North American ke beech. Book ke anusaar 1967 me McKenzie, Parker aur Morgan ne alag-alag kaam ko milakar plate tectonic siddhant diya; prithvi ka sthalmandal 7 badi aur kai chhoti plates me bata hai (Arabian, Philippine, Caroline, Fiji jaisi chhoti plates).

questions.q: The river valleys which drain in the same direction as the original consequent drainage but at the lower topographic levels which have developed with respect to new base levels. These valleys are known as:
questions.exp: Jo ghatiyan mool anuvarti (consequent) apvah ki disha me hi behti hain par naye aadhar tal ke hisaab se neeche ke star par viksit hoti hain, unhe navanuvarti (resequent) ghati kehte hain. Book apvah tantra ko do warg me baant'ti hai: kramvarti (anuvarti, paravarti, pratyanuvarti, navanuvarti) aur akramvarti. Navanuvarti sarita dwitiya apardan chakra me banti hai aur mool sarita se baad me banti hai.

questions.q: Which of the following processes is caused by alternate wetting and drying of rocks?
questions.exp: Chattano ke baar-baar geela aur sookha hone se unki satah dheeli hokar kamzor hoti hai – ise slaking kehte hain. Book ke anusaar: daab mukti se chattane parallel parton me tootna = chadari vighatan (sheeting); dabaav se chattano ke tukde tootkar alag hona = spalling; kisi kshetra ki chattan ki upari parat ka chhoti papdiyon me alag hona = flaking.

questions.q:
With reference to Endogenetic forces, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. Extreme events like earthquake and volcanic eruptions are caused by diastrophic forces.
2. Tensional forces cause upwarping and down warping.
questions.exp: Dono kathan galat. Bhookamp aur jwalamukhi jaisi aakasmik ghatnayein antarjat aakasmik (sudden) balon se hoti hain, diastrophic (patal-viroopan) balon se nahi. Upwarping aur downwarping (utsanvalan–avsanvalan) dabaav/sampeedan (compressional) balon se hota hai, tanav balon se nahi.

questions.q: Which one of the following is not correctly matched? (Agent of Erosion – Land form)
questions.exp: Blow hole (vaatchhidra) samudri lehron ka sthalroop hai, pawan ka nahi. Lehron ke jal-daab se kandara ki chhat ki hawa sikudkar chhat ko todti hai aur chhed ban jata hai. Samudri lehron ke apardani roop: tateey cliff, kandara, vaatchhidra, mehrab, stack, tarangghrisht vedika; nikshepani: puline, rodhika, hook, tombolo aadi. Plunge pool – nadi; tarn aur stack bhi sahi sumelit.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Delta's type) with List-II (Example):
(A) Arcuate Delta (B) Estuarine Delta (C) Bird-foot Delta (D) Abandoned Delta
1. Yellow river Delta 2. Mississippi river Delta 3. Mackenzie Delta 4. Nile Delta
questions.exp: Arcuate (chapakar) – Nile; Estuarine (jwarnadmukhi) – Mackenzie; Bird-foot (panjakar) – Mississippi; Abandoned (parityakt) – Yellow (Hwang Ho). Nadi jab samudra ya jheel me girti hai to veg kam hone se malba jama hokar delta banata hai; 'delta' shabd Nile ke muhane ke liye sabse pehle Herodotus ne prayog kiya.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Name) with List-II (Koeppen's Climate Sub type):
(A) BWh (B) BSh (C) BWk (D) BSk
1. Tropical Steppe Climate 2. Tropical Desert Climate 3. Middle Latitude Cold Steppe 4. Middle Latitude Cold Desert
questions.exp: BWh – ushna katibandhiya registani; BSh – ushna katibandhiya steppe; BWk – madhya akshanshiya registani (sheet); BSk – madhya akshanshiya steppe (sheet). Köppen ne 1900 me vanaspati ke aadhar par vargikaran diya, jo De Candolle (1874) ke vanaspati kshetron par aadharit tha; 1918, 1931 aur 1936 me sanshodhan kiye. Paanch mukhya varg A, B, C, D, E.

questions.q: Which one of the following is not correctly matched? (Local Wind – Region)
questions.exp: Bise France ki thandi sthaniya pawan hai, New Zealand ki nahi. Sahi jode: Zonda – Argentina, Levanter – dakshini Spain, Yamo – Japan, Chinook – Rocky (USA), Foehn – Alps, Bora – Adriatic tat, Mistral – France ki Rhone ghati.

questions.q: Who among the following established the thermal impact of High Tibet Plateau on the origin of Monsoon?
questions.exp: Monsoon ki utpatti me Tibet pathar ke taapiya prabhav ko Koteswaram aur Flohn ne mahatvapurn maana. Garmi me Tibet pathar (~5 km ooncha) aas-paas se 2–3°C zyada garam hota hai, upar prati-chakravat banta hai, Himalaya ke dakshin me uposhna paschimi jet kamzor padta hai aur poorvi (ushna katibandhiya) jet banta hai, jo neeche dakshin-paschim monsoon ko majboot karta hai.

questions.q: Which of the following types of rainfall mostly occurs during winter in Europe and North America?
questions.exp: Sardiyon me Europe aur North America me zyadatar varsha chakravati (cyclonic) hoti hai. Book Bhoomadhya-sagariya jalvayu (30°–40° akshansh, mahadweepon ke paschimi bhaag) ka udaharan deti hai: sardiyon me pawan petiyan dakshin khisakti hain, pachuva pawan aur chakravat varsha laate hain; garmi shushk rehti hai.

questions.q: In which of the following layers of the atmosphere lowest temperature is found?
questions.exp: Sabse kam taapmaan madhyamandal ki upari seema – mesopause (~80 km) par hota hai, lagbhag –100°C se –133°C tak. Iske upar taapmaan fir badhne lagta hai (taapiya pratilomana). Book: S. Petersen ne vayumandal ko 5 parton me baanta – kshobh, samtap, madhya, aayan aur bahya mandal.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Tropical Cyclone) with List-II (Country):
(A) Typhoons (B) Willi-Willis (C) Baigio (D) Taifu
1. Japan 2. Philippines 3. Australia 4. China
questions.exp: Typhoons – China; Willy-willies – Australia; Baguio – Philippines; Taifu – Japan.

questions.q: Which of the following is not correctly matched? (Ocean current – Flowing area)
o: Canary Current – Western coast of North Africa
Benguela Current – Eastern coast of South Africa
Falkland Current – Eastern coast of South America
Labrador Current – Coast of New foundland
questions.exp: Benguela jaldhara dakshin Africa ke paschimi tat ke sahare (dakshin se uttar) behti hai, poorvi tat par nahi. Ye thandi dhara hai jo aage dakshini vishuvatiya dhara me mil jati hai. Canary – uttar-paschim Africa ke paas thandi dhara; Falkland – Antarctic se aakar dakshin America ke poorvi tat ke sahare Argentina tak; Labrador – Baffin khadi/Davis jalsandhi se Newfoundland ke paas, jahan Gulf Stream se milkar ghana kohra banata hai.

questions.q:
With reference to the Coral Polyps, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. Corals are mainly found in the tropical oceans and seas where mean annual temperature ranges between 20°C and 21°C.
2. The area having oceanic salinity between 30‰ and 34‰ is most ideal for the growth and development of Coral Polyps.
questions.exp: Sirf kathan 1 sahi. Praval ushna katibandhiya mahasagaron me milte hain jahan ausat varshik taapmaan 20–21°C ho. Bahut zyada lavanta haanikarak hai kyunki usme calcium carbonate kam hota hai; praval ke liye uchit lavanta 27‰–30‰ honi chahiye, isliye kathan 2 galat. Praval Cnidaria (Coelenterata) sangh ke jeev hain; jaiv-vividhata ke kaaran inhe 'mahasagariya varshavan' kaha jata hai; global warming se praval viranjan.

questions.q: Which of the following topographical features covers largest area of the oceans?
questions.exp: Mahasagaron ka sabse bada kshetra gahre mahasagariya maidan (ocean basin) ka hai – lagbhag 75.9%. Book ke anusaar: mahadweepiya magn tat 8.6%, mahadweepiya magn dhaal 8.5%, mahasagariya gart ~7%. Sabse chauda magn tat Siberian shelf (1500 km); 20°–60° dakshini akshansh ke beech mahasagariya maidan ka adhiktam vistaar.

questions.q: Which of the following is a Cold Ocean Current?
questions.exp: Oyashio uttari Prashant ki thandi dhara hai (Kurile thandi dhara bhi kehte hain); Bering jalsandhi se aakar Japan ke paas garm Kuroshio se milkar ghana kohra banati hai. Antilles, Alaska aur Agulhas garm dharayein hain.

questions.q: Which of the following is not correctly matched? (Ocean Deposits – Source)
questions.exp: Is prashn me do jode galat hain: Red clay jaivik nahi, ajaivik (asthaniya) nikshep hai; aur kichad (mud) jwalamukhi nahi, sthaliya/bhoomij nikshep hai. Book ke anusaar aayog ne is prashn ko rad (*) kar diya tha. Sahi: ooze – jaivik, tektites – brahmandiya, mud – sthaliya, sand – jwalamukhi/sthaliya.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The oceans in the northern hemisphere record relatively higher average temperature than in the southern hemisphere.
Reason (R): The variation in the temperature in the northern and southern hemisphere is because of unequal distribution of land and ocean in both the hemispheres.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya hai. Uttari golardh me sthal adhik hone se mahasagaron ka ausat taapmaan dakshini golardh se zyada rehta hai. Book: mahasagaron ka ausat varshik taapmaan ~17.2°C; samtap rekhayein akshansh rekhaon ke lagbhag samantar; adhiktam taapmaan ayanvrittiya akshanshon ke paas.

questions.q: Which of the following is not correctly matched? (Ocean Trench – Ocean)
questions.exp: Mariana trench uttari Prashant mahasagar me hai, dakshini me nahi. Book ki gehraiyan: Mariana Challenger 11022 m (uttari Prashant), Tonga 10882 m (dakshini Prashant), Puerto Rico 8385 m (uttari Atlantic), Sunda/Java 7450 m (Hind), Kurile 10498 m, Romanche 7631 m, Diamantina 7299 m.

questions.q:
With reference to the Jet Stream, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. The velocity of Jet Stream in summer season becomes twice the velocity in winter season.
2. The extent of Jet Stream narrows down during summer season.
questions.exp: Sirf 2 sahi. Jet stream kshobhmandal ki upari seema ke paas tez paschimi pawan hain (7.5–14 km); sardiyon me tez (lagbhag 480 km/h tak) aur garmi me kamzor – yani garmi me veg sardi ka aadha hota hai, dugna nahi. Garmi me jet uttar khisakta hai aur uska vistaar sikud jata hai; sardi me 20° uttari akshansh tak faila rehta hai.

questions.q: Which of the following principles does not belong to logical positivism?
questions.exp: Vyavaharvad (behaviouralism) pratyakshvad se sambandhit nahi. 1820 ke dashak me Auguste Comte ne pratyakshvad diya – vastavik gyan tathyon aur anubhavon par aadharit hota hai jise vaigyanik vidhi se pramanit kiya ja sake; vikasit roop taarkik pratyakshvad. Kaaryakaran, sanrachanavad aur prakaryavad iske siddhant hain; vyavaharvad manav vyavhar ke gun-dharmon par zor deta hai.

questions.q: Who among the following is the propounder of the concept of Paradigm in Geography?
questions.exp: Chintan falak (paradigm) ki sankalpana Thomas Kuhn ki hai – pustak 'The Structure of Scientific Revolutions' (1962). Geography me iska pehla prayog Haggett aur Chorley ne 'Models in Geography' (1967) me kiya. 1972 me D. Harvey ke lekh 'Revolution and Counter Revolution' ke baad prachalit hua; Harvey ne 1979 me paradigm ko 'sankalpanatmak upkaran' kaha.

questions.q: Who among the following contributed in the development of Post modernism in Geography?
questions.exp: Uttar-adhunikvad ke vikas me Edward Soja ka yogdan hai. Unke anusaar uttar-adhunikvad vishwa ke vibhinn bhagon me 'aitihasikta' ke vichar ke virodh me hua. 1950 se 1980 tak pratyakshvad, sanrachanavad, vyavaharvad, manavtavad, tantra-vishleshan ne bhugol ko prabhavit kiya; geography me Dear (1986), R.D. Dixit (2000), Gregory ka mahatvapurn yogdan.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Books) with List-II (Authors):
(A) Erdkunde (B) Geographia Generalis (C) Anthropogeography (D) Cosmos
1. Humboldt 2. Ratzel 3. Varenius 4. Karl Ritter
questions.exp: Erdkunde – Carl Ritter; Geographia Generalis – Varenius; Anthropogeographie – Ratzel; Kosmos – Humboldt. Book ki aur pustakein: Ratzel – Political Geography; Humboldt – Kosmos; Jean Gottmann – Megalopolis; E.P. Odum – Ecology.

questions.q: In 1969 with the publication of which of the following journals the humanistic geography became the major paradigm of Geography?
questions.exp: Book ke anusaar 1969 me Worcester ke Clark University se Antipode patrika shuru hui, jisme ugra sudharvadi lekh chhape – nagariya nirdhanata, mahilaon ke saath bhedbhav, apradh, vanchan. Isse manavtavadi bhugol pramukh chintan falak bana. 'Humanistic geography' shabd sabse pehle Yi-Fu Tuan ne 1976 me prayog kiya; isne manav aur sthan ke sambandh ki jatilta par dhyan diya.

questions.q: The famous essay 'Exceptionalism in Geography: A methodological examination' was written by:
questions.exp: Ye nibandh F.K. Schaefer ne 1953 me likha (Iowa University). Isme unhone Hartshorne ki 'Nature of Geography' ki alochana ki; Schaefer–Hartshorne vivad ke baad geography sthaniya antarkriya ka vigyan bana aur kshetriy bhugol se hatkar siddhant-nirmaan ki or gaya. Note: 18vi sadi me Kant ko apvadvaad (exceptionalism) ka janak mana jata hai.

questions.q: Who among the following Geographers was not a proponent of Environmental Determinism?
questions.exp: Jean Brunhes sambhavvaadi (possibilist) the, nishchayvaadi nahi – ve Vidal de la Blache ke shishya the aur prakriti ki sambhavnaon ki baat karte the. Nishchayvaad ke samarthak: W.M. Davis, Huntington, Semple, Ratzel, Ritter, Humboldt; ye prakriti ko manav kriyaon ki niyantrak shakti maante the.

questions.q: Who among the following Scholars put forth the Seven stages of towns growth?
questions.exp: Griffith Taylor ne nagar vikas ki 7 avasthayein batayi: (1) poorv shaishav, (2) shaishav, (3) baal, (4) kishor, (5) praudh, (6) uttar praudh, (7) vriddh. Lewis Mumford ne 1938 me nagar vikas ki 6 avasthaon ka ullekh kiya.

questions.q: When was the Smart City mission launched in India?
questions.exp: 25 June 2015 ko PM Narendra Modi ne 100 Smart Cities Mission shuru kiya. Shahri Vikas Mantralaya ke under, rajya sarkaron ke sahyog se. Smart city ke buniyadi maanak: transport, awas, bijli-paani, shiksha, swasthya, Wi-Fi connectivity aadi.

questions.q: Who developed concept of urbanization as way of life?
questions.exp: Louis Wirth (Chicago School of Sociology) ne nagarikaran ko 'jeevan shaili' (way of life) ke roop me dekha. Unke anusaar shahar ke jeevan ke sakaratmak prabhav hote hain aur ye gaon ki krishi arthvyavastha ko udyog-vyapar aadharit arthvyavastha me badalne ki prakriya hai. Pustakein: The Ghetto, The Urban Mode of Life, Social Interaction, American Sociology.

questions.q: According to United Nations estimate in which of the following countries the annual rate of population growth during 2015-20 was the highest?
questions.exp: UN anuman ke anusaar 2015–20 me Bahrain ki varshik jansankhya vriddhi dar sabse zyada thi. Book: duniya ki jansankhya har saal ~8.3 crore (1.1%) badh rahi hai; 2017 me 7.6 arab, 2030 tak 8.6 arab aur 2050 tak 9.8 arab hone ka anuman.

questions.q: 'Law of Retail Gravitation' was propounded by:
questions.exp: Khudra gurutvakarshan niyam W.J. Reilly ne 1931 me diya. Do nagaron ke beech kisi basti se futtkar vyapar ki matra unki jansankhya ke anupaat me aur doori ke varg ke vyutkramanupaat me hoti hai: S1/S2 = (P1/P2)(D2/D1)². Gurutva/antarkriya niyam – H.C. Carey; alagav bindu siddhant – P.D. Converse.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Concept) with List-II (Propounder):
(A) City region (B) Umland (C) Hinterland (D) Urban field
1. Dickinson 2. Andre Allix 3. Green 4. Smailes
questions.exp: City region – Dickinson; Umland – Andre Allix; Hinterland (prishth pradesh) – Green; Urban field (nagariya kshetra) – Smailes.

questions.q: A 'dry point settlement' is a human settlement located on a site which is:
o: located in a hot dry region
not liable to flooding in a flood prone area
questions.exp: Shushk sthal adhivas wo basti hai jo baadh-prabhavit kshetra me aisi jagah ho jahan baadh ka paani na pahunche. Aise sthan oonche hote hain, jaise patthar ke tile, isliye log yahan tikaau ghar banate hain; deewarein oonchi aur andhi se surakshit gali.

questions.q: Which of the following factors was not used by D. Whittlesey (1936) to delineate agricultural regions of the world?
o: Processing and disposal of farm produce
questions.exp: Whittlesey (1936) ne vishwa ko krishi pradeshon me baantne ke liye 5 tatva liye: (1) faslon aur pashuon ka sah-sambandh, (2) krishi utpadan vidhi, (3) shram, poonji, sangathan ki gahanta, (4) krishi utpadon ka upyog aur nipatara, (5) krishi yantra, bhavan aadi. Inke aadhar par vishwa ko 13 krishi pradeshon me baanta. Bhoo-swamitva aur bhoo-dhriti iska aadhar nahi tha.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Types of Agriculture) with List-II (Country):
(A) Intensive Subsistence tillage (B) Commercial Plantation farming (C) Commercial Dairy farming (D) Market Gardening
1. Ivory Coast 2. Argentina 3. Bangladesh 4. Netherlands
questions.exp: Gahan nirvah krishi – Bangladesh; vanijyik bagati krishi – Ivory Coast; vanijyik dairy krishi – Argentina; bazaronmukh bagati (market gardening) – Netherlands.

questions.q: Among following scholars who presented the typology of world agriculture in 1972?
questions.exp: International Geographical Union ke krishi prakaar ayog ke adhyaksh J. Kostrowicki ne 1972 me vishwa krishi ka prakaarikaran prastut kiya; 1976 me sudhar karke pratham star ke 5, dwitiya star ke 20 aur tritiya star ke 55 krishi prakaar nirdharit kiye.

questions.q: In 1967 who identified 4 categories of agricultural efficiency in Uttar Pradesh?
questions.exp: S.S. Bhatia ne 1953–54 ke UP ke 47 jilon ka adhyayan karke 1967 me krishi kshamta ko 4 vargon me baanta. Unhone 9 faslon ki prati hectare paidavar ko liya. Krishi kshamta ke tatva: prati ikai kshetra utpadan, aagat-nirgat anupaat, prati ikai utpadan me shram, prati vyakti aavashyak anaaj.

questions.q: Which one of the following is not correctly matched? (Oil field – Country)
questions.exp: Al-Ghawar Saudi Arabia me hai, Iraq me nahi. Ye vishwa ka sabse bada tel kshetra hai – 1948 me khoja gaya, 1951 se utpadan; Saudi tel bhandaron ka lagbhag ek-chauthai. Saudi Aramco ise chalati hai.

questions.q: Which of the following is not related to Alfred Weber's theory of Industrial location?
questions.exp: Poorak kshetra (complementary area) Weber ke siddhant se sambandhit nahi. Alfred Weber ne 1909 me 'Über den Standort der Industrien' me nyuntam laagat siddhant diya (Angrezi anuvaad 1929). Pramukh sankalpanayein: sarvasulabh padarth, sthaniya padarth, shuddh padarth, mishrit padarth, padarth soochkank, sthaniya bhaar, isodapane, agglomeration, sthaniya trikon.

questions.q: J.C. Weaver first used the Statistical Technique for measuring Crop Combination of which of the following regions?
questions.exp: J.C. Weaver ne 1954 me sanyukt rajya America ke Madhya-Paschim (Mid-West) kshetra ke liye fasal sanyojan ki pehli sankhyiki vidhi lagayi (pasaran/variance sootra δ² = Σd²/n). Note: book ke anusaar is prashn par aayog ka uttar (c) maana gaya; book ne (*) chinhit kiya.

questions.q: Among the following scholars who first put forth the Global Strategic View Model?
questions.exp: Sarvapratham vaishvik rananeetik drishti model A.T. Mahan ne diya – pustak 'The Influence of Sea Power upon History' (1890). Unhone samudri shakti ko rajya ki shakti ka mukhya aadhar mana; USA ke liye shaktishali nausena, Caribbean dweepon aur Panama par niyantran, Pacific me thikane ki salah di.

questions.q: How many cultural realms of the first and the second order in the world have been put forth by Spencer and Thomas?
questions.exp: Spencer aur Thomas ne vishwa me prathama kram ke 11 aur dwitiya kram ke 50 sanskritik pradesh bataye (pustak 'Cultural Geography', 1969); unhone sanskritik pradeshon ko mandal, parimandal, prakhand aur kshetra me baanta. Russell, Kniffen aur Pruitt (1971) ne 7 sanskritik mandal; Broek ne vishwa ko 7 sanskritik mandalon aur 3 laghu parimandal me baanta.

questions.q: What is the rank of India in Human Development Index (HDI), 2021 in the world?
questions.exp: UNDP ke 2021 me jaari HDI me Bharat 0.645 maan ke saath 189 deshon me 131ve sthaan par tha. Norway 0.957 maan ke saath sheersh par, Ireland aur Switzerland sanyukt doosre sthaan par.

questions.q: The relationship among power structure, the environment and economic inequalities is termed as:
questions.exp: Shakti sanrachana, paryavaran aur aarthik asamanta ke sambandh ko rajneetik paristhitiki (political ecology) kehte hain. Ye rajneetik, aarthik aur samajik tatvon ke paryavaraniya muddon se sambandh ka adhyayan hai; iske samarthak maante hain ki paryavaran sambandhi mudde rajneeti aur arthvyavastha se alag nahi kiye ja sakte.

questions.q: 'Race is a valid biological concept, it is a group united by heredity, a breed or genetic strain or sub species, it is not a valid socio-cultural concept'. Who gave this statement?
questions.exp: Ye kathan Kroeber ka hai. Prajati (race) ek jaivik sankalpana hai – vanshanukram se jude samooh. 'Race' shabd ka pehla prayog Francis ne 'Book of Martyrs' me kiya; iski utpatti Italian 'Razza' se mani jati hai jiska arth vansh ya nasl.

questions.q: Who among the following Arab scholars made corrections to the Ptolemy's book?
questions.exp: Al-Idrisi 12vi sadi ke agrani Arab bhugolvetta the jinhone Ptolemy ki pustak me sudhar kiya – Hind mahasagar, Caspian sagar, kai Europiya nadiyon aur Danube ke vivran theek kiye. Unhone vishwa ka maanchitra banaya aur 'Vishwa bhraman ke ichhuk logon ke liye manoranjan' naamak pustak likhi.

questions.q: Who delineated planning regions of India with the help of quantitative maps of distribution of important natural resources?
o: L.S. Bhatt and V.L.S. Prakash Rao
questions.exp: L.S. Bhat aur V.L.S. Prakasa Rao ne sansadhan vikas hetu niyojan pradesh banaye; pramukh sansadhanon ke vitaran ke gunatmak maanchitron ki sahayata se. Rajya seemaon ke aar-paar faile 7 pramukh aur 51 sookshm pradesh – dakshin bharat, poorvi bharat, uttar-poorvi bharat, madhya Ganga maidan, uttar-paschimi bharat aadi.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a nodal region?
questions.exp: Rashtriya Rajdhani Kshetra (NCR) kendriya (nodal) pradesh ka udaharan hai. D. Whittlesey ke anusaar nodal pradesh ek mool sthaan (kendra) ke chaaron or vikasit hota hai jahan kendra ka sevaon par adhikaar hota hai.

questions.q: The concept of region as trinity of place, folk and work was propagated by which of the following scholars?
questions.exp: Sthaan-lok-karya (place-folk-work) ki sankalpana Patrick Geddes ki hai: kisi sthaan ka paryavaran, wahan ke log aur unki aarthik kriya ek trayi banate hain. Geddes ne Britain me pradeshik sarvekshan aur niyojan ko vyavharik roop diya; 'conurbation' shabd bhi unhone diya.

questions.q: How many basic principles of regional planning have been mentioned by R.C. Chandna in his book 'Regional Planning' (2002)?
questions.exp: R.C. Chandna ne 'Regional Planning' (2002) me 7 aadharbhoot siddhant bataye: oordhvadhar ekta, kshetriy sthaniyata, desh-kaal santulan, samagra vikas, samajik vanchana aur aarthik vyavaharikta ke beech santulan, samuday vikas, paristhitik santulan.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Concept) with List-II (Scholar):
(A) Settlement Hierarchy (B) Regional Analysis (C) Growth Pole Theory (D) Stages of Economic Growth
1. F Perroux 2. Walter Christaller 3. Walter Isard 4. W.W Rostow
questions.exp: Adhivasiya padanukram – Walter Christaller; kshetriy vishleshan – Walter Isard; vikas dhruv siddhant – F. Perroux; aarthik vriddhi ki avasthayein – W.W. Rostow.

questions.q: A map on R.F. 1 : 50,000 is enlarged by two times, what will be the scale of the enlarged map?
questions.exp: Maanchitra ko jitne guna bada kiya jaye, maapni ki bhinna ke har ko utne se bhaag dete hain: 50,000 ÷ 2 = 25,000, yani nayi maapni 1 : 25,000.

questions.q: Who defined regional planning as the process of formulating and clarifying social objectives in the ordering of activities in Supra-Urban Space?
questions.exp: Pradeshik niyojan ko adhinagariya kshetra me gatividhiyon ki vyavastha me samajik uddeshyon ko tay aur spasht karne ki prakriya ke roop me John Friedmann ne paribhashit kiya. Unhone 1966 me Venezuela ke vikas neeti ke vishleshan me 'kendra-paridhi model' diya.

questions.q: Which of the following is not correctly matched? (Tribal Community – Region)
o: Masai – East African Savanna grass land
questions.exp: Bushman Kalahari marusthal (dakshin Africa) ki janjati hai, Sudan ki nahi. Sahi: Kirghiz – Madhya Asia, Masai – poorvi Africa ka savanna, Pygmy – Congo basin.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Lake) with List-II (Location in India):
(A) Sala Lake (B) Chandubi Lake (C) Bhrigu Lake (D) Umiam Lake
1. Meghalaya 2. Himachal Pradesh 3. Assam 4. Arunachal Pradesh
questions.exp: Sala jheel – Arunachal Pradesh; Chandubi – Assam; Bhrigu – Himachal Pradesh; Umiam – Meghalaya.

questions.q:
With reference to El-Nino which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. El-Nino is Cold Ocean current
2. It appears around Christmas in December along the Coast of Peru in Pacific Ocean
questions.exp: Sirf 2 sahi. El Niño garm dhara hai (thandi nahi) jo December me Christmas ke aas-paas Peru tat (dakshin America ke paschim) par prakat hoti hai; ise 'vipreet dhara' bhi kehte hain. Sardi me Peru tat ka taapmaan 3–4°C tak badh jata hai; is saal Peru me bhaari varsha aur poorvi Prashant (Indonesia, Australia, Bharat) me sookha padne ki sambhavna rehti hai.

questions.q: Which of the following soils is rich in Potash but poor in Phosphorus?
questions.exp: Jalod (alluvial) mrida potash me samriddh par phosphorus me kam hoti hai. Ye nadiyon dwara laaye avsadon se banti hai; lagbhag 15 lakh varg km – desh ke kul kshetra ka ~43.4%. Nitrogen, phosphorus aur humus ki kami, par potash aur choona paryapt. Teen varg: tarai, bangar, khadar.

questions.q: Which of the following mountain passes is located in Ladakh range?
questions.exp: Khardung La Ladakh shreni me hai; Leh ke uttar, Shyok aur Nubra ghati ko jodta hai. Banihal – Pir Panjal shreni (J&K), jahan 1956 me Jawahar Tunnel bani. Jelep La – Sikkim (Chumbi ghati se Tibet ko jodta hai).

questions.q: How long is the length of the equator drawn for entire globe on the Gall's projection?
o: Equal to the actual length of equator
Equal to the actual length of 45° latitude
Half of the actual length of the equator
Equal to the length of 60° latitude
questions.exp: Gall ke projection me bhoomadhya rekha ki lambai 45° akshansh ki vastavik lambai ke barabar hoti hai. Ye sanshodhit belanakar projection hai jisme har akshansh vritt 45° akshansh vritt ke barabar; ise vishwa ke saamanya maanchitron ke liye upyogi mana jata hai.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Minerals) with List-II (Mining fields of India):
(A) Copper (B) Iron ore (C) Zinc (D) Gold
1. Hatti 2. Badam Pahari 3. Khetri 4. Zawar
questions.exp: Tamba – Khetri (Rajasthan); lauh – Badampahar (Odisha); jasta – Zawar (Rajasthan); sona – Hatti (Karnataka).

questions.q: Which principle applies in the case of K=7 hierarchy of central places as per Christaller's Theory of 'Central Place'?
questions.exp: K=7 prashasan (administration) niyam hai. Christaller ne 1933 me dakshin Germany ke adhyayan par kendra sthal siddhant diya. K=3 – bazaar niyam, K=4 – parivahan niyam, K=7 – prashasan niyam; kendra sthal shatkoniya praroop me.

questions.q: Which of the following types of Spectrum of Remote Sensing would be best suited for locating deforestation?
questions.exp: Vanon ki kataai ka pata lagane ke liye False Colour Composite (FCC) sabse upyogi hai. Isme drishya prakash ke alawa doosre band (jaise near-infrared) bhi prayog hote hain; FCC me swasth vanaspati chamkdar laal dikhti hai aur nangi zameen ya kati vanaspati alag dikhti hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is not a bivariate correlation method?
questions.exp: Aanshik sahsambandh (partial correlation) dwichar vidhi nahi hai – isme do se adhik charon ka adhyayan hota hai aur kuch charon ka prabhav sthir maana jata hai. Karl Pearson, Spearman aur nyuntam varg vidhi dwichar sahsambandh hain. Sahsambandh ke prakaar: dhanatmak/rinatmak, rekhiy/vakrarekhiy, saral/aanshik/bahugun.

questions.q: Which one of the following is most suitable to show the inequality in the distribution?
questions.exp: Vitaran ki asamanta dikhane ke liye Lorenz curve sabse upyukt hai – dhan, aay, labh jaise vitaran ki asamanta maapne ki graphic vidhi; sabse pehle Dr. Max O. Lorenz ne prayog kiya.

questions.q: When was the Indian Satellite 'Earth Observation Satellite-3 (EOS-3)' which is a remote sensing satellite, launched?
questions.exp: EOS-3 (GISAT-1) ko ISRO ne 12 August 2021 ko Sriharikota se GSLV-F10 se launch kiya, par cryogenic stage me kharabi se mission asafal raha. Bhoo-avlokan (earth observation) satellite prithvi ke bhautik, rasayanik, jaivik tantra ki jaankari ikattha karte hain – jasoosi, paryavaran nigrani, mausam, cartography me upyog.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Remote sensing and GIS are associated with the analysis of elements of spatial importance.
Reason (R): Remote sensing and GIS are important sources of spatial data.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya hai. Remote sensing aur GIS dono sthaniya aankdon ke mahatvapurn srot hain, isliye sthaniya mahatva ke tatvon ke vishleshan se jude hain. Remote sensing = door se kisi vastu ya satah ke baare me jaankari prapt karna; GIS = computer aadharit tantra jo aankdon ka sangrah, vishleshan aur pradarshan karta hai.

questions.q: In which of the following cartographic methods the interpolation is used?
questions.exp: Samman rekha (isopleth) vidhi me antarveshan (interpolation) ka prayog hota hai. Ye maanchitra par saman maan wale sthanon ko jodne wali rekhayein hain – samtap, samdaab, samvarsha aadi; jalvayu tatvon, lavanta, bhookamp prabhav aadi dikhane me upyog.

questions.q: Which of the following is correct sequence of sampling techniques under probability sampling?
questions.exp: Sambhavya pratichayan ka sahi kram: daiv (random) – stareekrit (stratified) – kramabaddh (systematic) – guchchhit (cluster). Quota aur purposive asambhavya pratichayan hain.

questions.q: The progressive reduction of relief through long-term interaction of endogenetic uplift and exogenetic denudation is most appropriately conceptualized as:
o: Parallel slope retreat independent of base level
Dynamic equilibrium between uplift and denudation
questions.exp: Book: bhootal par do srot ke bal kaam karte hain – antarjat (uthaan, asamanta badhate) aur bahirjat (apardan, asamanta ghatate). Dono ke beech lagatar santulan ki prakriya se hi raahat dheere-dheere kam hoti hai – ise uthaan aur nirakaran ke beech gatisheel santulan kehte hain.

questions.q: The geosynclinal theory of mountain building fundamentally assumed:
o: Lateral compression due to mantle convection currents
Vertical subsidence and sediment accumulation followed by compression
questions.exp: Geosyncline siddhant me pehle lambi, sankri, chhichhli jalpoorn droni me lagatar avsadan aur avtalan (vertical subsidence) hota hai, baad me sampeedan se parvat bante hain. Kober (1925): droni ke dono kinaron ke kathor bhookhand (foreland/agradesh) ek-doosre ki or khisakkar avsadon ko mod dete hain; madhya pind (median mass) ki sankalpana bhi unhi ki.

questions.q: A coastal stretch showing raised beaches, marine terraces and inland shifted wave-cut platforms indicates:
o: Isostatic uplift relative to sea level
questions.exp: Ooonche samudra tat, samudri vedikayein aur andar khiske wave-cut platform batate hain ki tat samudra tal ke sapeksh ooncha utha hai – samasthitik (isostatic) utthaan. Isostasy shabd Greek 'isostasios' se; pehla prayog Dutton (1889). Siddhant: ooncha uthe bhaag kam ghanatva ke aur dhanse bhaag adhik ghanatva ke, taaki 'samtolan tal' par sab santulit rahe.

questions.q: The coexistence of U-shaped valleys, hanging valleys and truncated spurs in a fluvial landscape implies:
o: Glacial overprinting on pre-existing river valleys
questions.exp: U-aakar ghati, latakti ghati aur kate spurs ek saath milna batata hai ki pehle se bani nadi ghatiyon par baad me himnad ne apna prabhav chhoda (glacial overprinting). Himnad V-ghati ko chauda-gehra karke U banata hai, sahayak ghatiyan oonchi rah jati hain (latakti ghati) aur ghaati ke spurs kat jate hain.

questions.q: The Principle of isostasy explains post-glacial rebound primarily due to:
questions.exp: Isostasy ke anusaar himnad pighalne ke baad bhaar hatne se sthalmandal asthenosphere ke upar lochdar dhang se wapas upar uthta hai (post-glacial rebound). Saamanya arth: prithvi ki satah ke oonche-neeche bhaagon me ek talpar santulan rehta hai; oonchai ke vyutkramanupaat me ghanatva hota hai.

questions.q: A river exhibiting graded profile, floodplain widening and meander cut-offs reflects dominance of:
questions.exp: Shrenibaddh (graded) profile ka arth nadi praudh/vriddh avastha me hai, jahan oordhvadhar apardan lagbhag khatam aur parshv (lateral) apardan tatha nikshep pramukh hote hain. Nadi ghumavdar banti hai, kat-off bante hain aur baadh ka maidan chauda hota jata hai.

questions.q: Karst topography is most intensively developed where limestone areas exhibit:
questions.exp: Karst sabse achha wahan banta hai jahan ghulansheel choona-patthar ke neeche abhedya parat ho. Bhoomigat jal ka kaarya oopar ki ghulansheel chattano tak simit rehta hai aur ghulan (solution) ke kaaran gart, kandaraein ityadi banti hain; neeche abhedya parat hone se jal neeche nahi rishta.

questions.q: At night in winter at higher latitudes, the net radiation balance at the Earth's surface becomes negative primarily because:
o: High albedo of land surfaces during winter nights
Outgoing longwave radiation exceeding incoming shortwave radiation
Sensible heat transfer to upper atmosphere
Latent heat release during condensation at night time
questions.exp: Sardi ki raaton me ucch akshanshon par prithvi se jaane wala deerghtarang (longwave) vikiran aane wale laghutarang (shortwave) se zyada ho jata hai, isliye shuddh vikiran santulan rinatmak ho jata hai. Saamanya roop se prithvi aur vayumandal sauryatap aur bahirgami vikiran ke beech santulan banaye rakhte hain.

questions.q: Lowest temperature is recorded at which of the following layer/region in the atmosphere?
questions.exp: Sabse kam taapmaan mesopause par (~80 km) – lagbhag –100°C se –133°C. Madhyamandal 50–80 km tak, oonchai ke saath taapmaan girta hai. Stratopause par ozone adhiktam; Teisserenc de Bort ne 1902 me samtap mandal khoja.

questions.q: According to Koppen's classification, the boundary between 'C' and 'D' climates is primarily determined by:
questions.exp: Köppen me C aur D ke beech seema sabse thande mahine ke taapmaan se tay hoti hai. Book: C me sabse thande mahine ka taapmaan 18°C aur –3°C ke beech; D me sabse thande mahine ka taapmaan –3°C se kam aur sabse garam ka 10°C se adhik. Köppen ka vargikaran 1900 (De Candolle 1874 par aadharit), sanshodhan 1918, 1931, 1936.

questions.q: The thermal wind relationship explains the formation of upper air westerlies as a function of:
questions.exp: Taapiya pawan sambandh ke anusaar oopari paschimi hawaayein kshaitij taapmaan pravanata (dhruv aur vishuvat ke taapmaan antar) ka parinaam hain. Jitna zyada taapmaan antar, utni tez paschimi hawa – isliye sardi me jet stream tez hoti hai.

questions.q: In a mature tropical cyclone, the maximum rainfall is generally associated with:
questions.exp: Paripakva ushna katibandhiya chakravat me adhiktam varsha netra-bhitti (eye wall) kshetra me hoti hai. Kendra me shaant 'aankh' (vyas ~10–50 km) hoti hai; uske charon or tez hawaon aur ghane kapasi-varsha meghon ki deewar me sabse tez hawa aur sabse bhaari varsha hoti hai.

questions.q: The descending limb of the Hadley Cell contributes directly to the formation of:
questions.exp: Hadley cell ki avrohi bhuja 30° akshansh ke paas neeche utarti hai, wahan uposhna ucch dabaav aur shushk sthitiyan banti hain – isliye uposhna katibandhiya registan. G. Hadley ne 1735 me ye sanchalan cell bataya; vishuvat par garm hawa oopar uthkar 8–12 km par dhruvon ki or jaati hai aur 30° par neeche utarti hai.

questions.q: The lapse rate inversion during winter nights in valleys is mainly attributed to:
questions.exp: Sardi ki raaton me ghati me taap pratilomana mukhyatah satah ki hawa ke vikiran dwara thande hone se hota hai. Pahadi dhalon ki hawa thandi aur bhaari hokar neeche ghati me jama hoti hai, oopar garm hawa rehti hai – ghati ki tali me kohra/pala.

questions.q: The deepest parts of the ocean basins are generally associated with which of the following tectonic settings?
o: Divergent plate margins with mid-oceanic ridges
Transform plate boundaries with fracture zones
Convergent plate margins with subduction zones
Passive continental margins with wide continental shelves
questions.exp: Mahasagaron ke sabse gehre bhaag (gart) abhisari plate seemaon ke subduction kshetron se jude hain – bhaari plate halki plate ke neeche dhansti hai aur gehri khai banti hai; saath me jwalamukhi dweep chaap bhi.

questions.q: The sequential development of fringing, barrier and atoll reefs is primarily associated with:
o: Eustatic rise in sea level without crustal movement
questions.exp: Charles Darwin ke avtalan siddhant ke anusaar jwalamukhi dweep ke dheere-dheere doobne se pehle tateey (fringing) bhitti, phir avrodhak (barrier) aur ant me atoll banta hai – beech ka dweep doob jata hai aur lagoon bacha rehta hai.

questions.q: The global distribution of tropical rainforests corresponds most closely with:
o: Regions of descending air in subtropical highs
Cold ocean currents along western margins
Areas under the influence of ITCZ convergence
Continental interiors with high annual range of temperature
questions.exp: Ushna katibandhiya varsha van ITCZ (antar-ushna abhisaran kshetra) ke prabhav wale kshetron se mel khaate hain. Vishuvat ke paas sarvadhik suryatap se sanvahan dharayein uthti hain, roz dopahar baad ghanghor varsha hoti hai; ye 10°N–10°S ke beech.

questions.q: The principle of ecological succession predicts that maximum biomass and species diversity are generally achieved during:
questions.exp: Paristhitik uttaradhikar ka siddhant batata hai ki adhiktam jaivbhar aur prajati vividhata charam (climax) samudayik avastha me milti hai. Anukramik vikas ki antim avastha charam samuday hai, jahan tantra santulan me hota hai.

questions.q: Increased sea surface temperature due to climate change is most likely to result in:
o: Decrease in metabolic stress in reef organisms
questions.exp: Samudri satah ka taapmaan badhne se praval aur zooxanthellae shaival ka sahjeevi sambandh toot jata hai – shaival bahar nikal jaate hain aur praval safed ho jata hai (praval viranjan). Viranjan ka arth hai shaival ke na rehne se praval ka rang udna.

questions.q: The ozone depletion over polar regions is intensified by:
questions.exp: Dhruvon par ozone kshay dhruviya samtapmandaliya badal (PSC) banne se tez hota hai. Antarctic sardi me taapmaan –84°C tak; nitric acid aur barf ke kan bante hain; August–September me dhoop aane par in badalon par ozone todne wali kriyaein tez hoti hain.

questions.q: The concept of sustainable development is best reflected in:
questions.exp: Satat vikas ka saar peedhi dar peedhi samanta aur sansadhan sanrakshan hai. Brundtland Commission (1987) ki report 'Our Common Future': aisa vikas jo vartaman ki zarooratein poori kare bina bhavishya ki peedhiyon ki kshamata ko nuksaan pahunchaye.

questions.q: The geographical description in the Puranas reflects a cosmographic world view characterized by:
questions.exp: Puranon ka bhaugolik vivaran brahmandiya drishtikon dikhata hai jisme pauranik-prateekatmak sthaniya sanrachana hai – dweep, varsh, parvat, nadiyan dharm-darshan ke saath varnit. Vayu, Matsya, Vishnu, Markandeya aur Bhagavat Puran me bhaugolik vivaran milta hai.

questions.q: The epistemological basis of major dualisms/dichotomies in geography is fundamentally rooted in:
questions.exp: Bhugol ke pramukh dvaitvad (prakriti–sanskriti, bhautik–manav, vishay–vastu) ka gyanmimansa aadhar Descartes ka dvaitvad (Cartesian dualism) hai – mann aur sharir ko alag maanna. Isse bhautik aur manav bhugol ka vibhajan aaya.

questions.q: In locational analysis, the principle of spatial interaction is theoretically grounded in:
questions.exp: Sthaniya vishleshan me sthaniya antarkriya ka siddhant gurutvakarshan model par aadharit hai – do sthanon ke beech antarkriya unki jansankhya ke anupaat me aur doori ke vyutkramanupaat me. Isme pravas, vastuon aur sevaon ka aadan-pradan, yatayat aadi shamil.

questions.q: The Quantitative Revolution in geography redefined spatial analysis primarily through the adoption of:
questions.exp: Matratmak kranti ne sankhyiki anuman aur model-nirmaan ke madhyam se sthaniya vishleshan ko naya roop diya. USA me Iowa, Wisconsin aur Washington vishwavidyalayon ke bhugolvettaon ne iska netritva kiya; gaanitiya aur sankhyiki vidhiyon se bhugol ko vaigyanik aur tarksangat banaya.

questions.q: The behavioural approach in geography emerged as a critique of quantitative geography mainly because of its:
questions.exp: Vyavaharvaadi drishtikon matratmak bhugol ki is kami ki aalochana me aaya ki usne manav ki sangyanatmak (cognitive) prakriyaon ki upeksha ki. 1960 ke dashak me mahsoos hua ki matratmak kranti manav jeevan ki vastavikta se kat rahi hai; manasik maanchitron ka adhyayan shuru hua.

questions.q: Radical geography interprets spatial organization primarily through the lens of:
questions.exp: Radical bhugol sthaniya sangathan ko rajneetik arthvyavastha aur varg sambandhon ki drishti se dekhta hai. 1960 ke uttarardh me pratyakshvad ki pratikriya me ubhra; Marxvaad par aadharit – poonjivaad, vargon ka shoshan, gareebi, asamanta ke sthaniya roop.

questions.q:
Arrange the following paradigms in chronological order in the evolution of modern geographical thought.
(A) Determinism (B) Quantitative Revolution (C) Behavioural Approach (D) Possibilism
questions.exp: Kram: Nishchayvaad (19vi sadi ant–20vi shuru, ~1880–1920) → Sambhavvaad (~1900–1930) → Matratmak kranti (~1950–1960) → Vyavaharvaadi drishtikon (1960–70 ke dashak).

questions.q: Population mobility transition theory suggests that types of migration vary systematically with stages of societal development. Identify the stage associated with dominant rural-to-urban migration and rapid urban growth.
questions.exp: Gatisheelta sankraman siddhant (Zelinsky) ke anusaar pramukh gramin-se-shahri pravas aur tez shahri vikas prarambhik sankramanshil samaj ki pehchan hai. Is avastha me krishi sudhar, udyog aur shahron me rozgaar badhte hain; gaon se shahar ki or bada palayan aur jhuggi jaisi samasyayein.

questions.q: Identify the migration process that involves movement through a series of intermediate stages rather than a single direct relocation.
questions.exp: Kadam (step) sthanantaran me vyakti seedhe antim gantavya na jaakar beech ke kai padavon se hota hai – jaise gaon → kasba → zila mukhyalay → mahanagar. Har padav par naye vatavaran me dhalta hai aur jaankari jutata hai.

questions.q: Population density as an indicator of human pressure on land becomes analytically stronger when combined with which of the following measures?
questions.exp: Bhoomi par manav dabaav ka sanketak tab zyada majboot hota hai jab ise shaaririk (physiological) ghanatva ke saath joda jaye – kul jansankhya / kul krishi yogya bhoomi. Ye prati ikai krishi bhoomi par logon ka bhaar dikhata hai.

questions.q: According to the Lee's migration model, which type of factor at the place of origin is most likely to initiate the migration decision?
questions.exp: Lee (1966) ke model me mool sthaan par dhakka (push) kaarakon ka moolyankan pravas nirnay shuru karta hai. Chaar kaarak: mool sthaan, gantavya, madhyavarti avrodh, vyaktigat kaarak. Push – praakritik prakop, berozgaari, sansadhan kami; pull – shahron me rozgaar aur suvidhayein.

questions.q: In population-resource regionalization, regions categorized as 'United State type' generally display which combination of characteristics?
o: Sparse population with minimal technological development
Low technology with scarce resources and dense population
High population pressure with subsistence economy
High technology with abundant resources and moderate population density
questions.exp: Jansankhya-sansadhan kshetriyakaran me 'USA prakaar' ke kshetron me ucch praudyogiki, prachur sansadhan aur madhyam jansankhya ghanatva hota hai. Sansadhan jansankhya se adhik, prati vyakti aay aur jeevan star ucch – USA, Canada, Australia, NZ, Russia ke bhaag.

questions.q: A country experiencing rapid industrialization records declining death rates followed by delayed fertility decline due to cultural persistence. The demographic outcome is most likely:
questions.exp: Mrityu dar girne ke baad sanskritik kaaranon se janam dar der se girti hai to jansankhya visphot ki avastha aati hai – jansankhyiki sankraman ki doosri avastha. Swasthya-chikitsa sudhar se mrityu dar tez girti hai par janam dar ooncha rehti hai.

questions.q: Which one of the following is the simplest measure of population density?
questions.exp: Ankganitiya ghanatva sabse saral maap hai = pradesh ki kul jansankhya / kul kshetrafal. Ye prati ikai kshetra me logon ki ausat sankhya batata hai.

questions.q: Identify the correct statement regarding the distinction between renewable and non-renewable natural resources within the framework of economic geography and resource conservation.
o: Non-renewable resources are unaffected by technological changes in extraction
Non-renewable resources regenerate through natural cycles within decades
Renewable resources are always inexhaustible regardless of consumption rate
Renewable resources regenerate within a human time scale if properly managed
questions.exp: Navikarniya sansadhan, agar theek se prabandhit hon, manav samay paimane ke andar punah utpann ho jaate hain. Anavikarniya (jeevashm indhan) bhoovaigyanik samay me bante hain aur praudyogiki se nikasi kshamta badalti hai; akshay sansadhan (saur, pawan) bhi galat prabandhan se ghat sakte hain.

questions.q:
Match the following industrial characteristics with appropriate industrial type:
(A) Aluminium smelting (B) Software development (C) Petrochemical industry (D) Diamond cutting
p. Footloose industry q. Resource-based industry r. Skilled labour-oriented industry s. Energy intensive industry
questions.exp: Aluminium galana – urja gahan; software – footloose; petrochemical – sansadhan aadharit; diamond cutting – kushal shram unmukh.

questions.q: Identify the correct relationship between accessibility, connectivity and transport cost within spatial economic systems.
o: Higher accessibility generally reduces effective transport cost in regional economies
Higher connectivity always increases transport cost due to infrastructure maintenance
Accessibility and connectivity are unrelated to spatial interaction
Transport cost remains constant regardless of network density
questions.exp: Ucch pahunch-kshamta aam taur par prabhavi parivahan laagat ko kam karti hai. Achhi sadak/rail network se samay aur indhan bachta hai; pahunch aur sanyojakta sthaniya antarkriya se gehre jude hain.

questions.q:
Arrange the following agricultural revolutions in chronological order of their historical emergence.
(A) Green Revolution (B) Neolithic Agricultural Revolution (C) Second Agricultural Revolution (D) Gene Revolution
questions.exp: Kram: Navpashan krishi kranti (~7000 BC) → Doosri krishi kranti (1815–1880, Europe) → Harit kranti (1950s ke baad, Rockefeller aur Ford Foundation) → Jeen kranti (1990s; Bharat me 2002 me Bt kapas ki anumati).

questions.q: In Von Thunen's model, agricultural land rent is theoretically obtained by:
o: Dividing market price by transport intensity
Adding transport cost to production cost and market price
Multiplying output by distance from market
Subtracting production and transport costs from the market value of the produce
questions.exp: Von Thünen ke model me lagaan = bazaar moolya − (utpadan laagat + parivahan laagat). Sootra: P = V − (E + T). Pustak 'The Isolated State' (1826); vibhinn faslein kendriya nagar ke charon or sankendriya pattiyon me.

questions.q: Indentify the most appropriate inference when transport cost decline substantially due to technological innovation in a region dominated by resource-based industries.
o: Spatial concentration near resource sites becomes less rigid
Industrial location becomes independent of labour supply
questions.exp: Takniki navachar se parivahan laagat bahut ghatne par sansadhan sthalon ke paas udyogon ka jamav kam kathor ho jata hai – kachcha maal door le jana sasta ho jata hai, isliye udyog sansadhan sthal se door bhi lag sakte hain.

questions.q:
Arrange the following economic sectors in increasing order of knowledge intensity within modern economic system.
(A) Primary sector (B) Secondary sector (C) Tertiary sector (D) Quaternary sector
questions.exp: Gyan gahanta ka badhta kram: prathamik < dwitiyak < tritiyak < chaturthak. Prathamik (krishi, khanan) – 'laal collar'; dwitiyak (vinirmaan) – 'neela collar'; tritiyak (sevayein) – 'gulabi collar'; chaturthak (shodh, soochna) – 'safed collar'.

questions.q: In the context of classical geopolitical theories, the strategic relevance of the Eurasian core area is best expressed by which proposition?
o: Control of the sea routes determines control of the Eurasian interior
Control of Eastern Europe enables dominance over the Eurasian core and eventually the world
Control of the Tropical colonies determines global political supremacy
Control of polar routes determines control of the continental heart
questions.exp: Mackinder ke anusaar Poorvi Europe ka niyantran Eurasian core (heartland) par prabhutva deta hai aur ant me vishwa par. 'Jo Poorvi Europe par shasan karega wo hrdayasthal par, jo hrdayasthal par wo vishwa dweep par, jo vishwa dweep par wo vishwa par.'

questions.q:
Match the geopolitical thinkers with their major propositions:
(A) Halford Mackinder (B) Nicholas Spykman (C) Karl Haushofer (D) Alfred Thayer Mahan
i. Sea power determines world dominance ii. Heartland concept iii. Rimland strategic control iv. Geopolitik and expansion of Lebensraum
questions.exp: Mackinder – Heartland; Spykman – Rimland; Haushofer – Geopolitik aur Lebensraum ka vistaar; Mahan – samudri shakti vishwa prabhutva tay karti hai.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding Rimland theory:
(A) The Rimland forms a intermediate zone between maritime and continental powers.
(B) Control of the Rimland determines access to Eurasian interior and seas.
(C) The theory rejects the strategic significance of maritime routes.
(D) It emphasizes coastal and peripheral Eurasian regions.
Which combination is most consistent with the Rimland thesis?
questions.exp: A, B aur D sahi; C galat. Spykman ne 'The Geography of the Peace' (1944) me rimland ko heartland ke bahar ki tateey-paridhiya patti bataya – samudri aur mahadweepiya shaktiyon ke beech madhyavarti kshetra. 'Jo rimland ko niyantrit karega wo Eurasia par shasan karega.' Samudri marg uske liye mahatvapurn the.

questions.q: Administrative boundaries that coincide with ethnic divisions are most likely to produce which geopolitical outcome?
o: Stabilization through recognition of identity territories
questions.exp: Jatiya vibhajan ke saath mel khaane wali prashasanik seemayein pehchan kshetron ki manyata se sthirata laati hain. Nrijatiya seemaon ka uddeshya samuday ki bhaugolik-rajneetik abhivyakti ko vaidhanik roop dena hai; par kabhi alpsankhyak samasya bhi.

questions.q: In social geography, the concept of social well-being is most appropriately evaluated through which integrated indicator set?
questions.exp: Samajik kalyan ka moolyankan swasthya, shiksha aur aay ki uplabdhiyon ke ekikrit sanketakon se hota hai. Samajik bhugol ke upshakha: vyavaharvaadi, kalyan, avkash, sanskritik, chikitsa bhugol aadi.

questions.q: Administrative areas created primarily for governance efficiency rather than cultural or physical homogeneity are best understood as:
o: Formal regions determined by natural features
Functional regions determined by economic specialization
Institutional regions established through administrative authority
Culture regions defined by linguistic uniformity
questions.exp: Shasan dakshata ke liye bane prashasanik kshetra sansthagat (institutional) kshetra kehlate hain – ye bhautik ya sanskritik ekroopta par nahi, prashasanik shaktiyon aur niyamon par bante hain.

questions.q: The impact of globalization on Indian cultural landscapes is most strongly reflected in which spatial transformation pattern?
o: Replacement of regional identities with ecological zones
Hybridization of cultural practices across urban networks
Isolation of tribal communities from external influences
questions.exp: Vaishvikaran ka prabhav shahri networks me sanskritik prathaon ke sankaran (hybridization) me sabse zyada dikhta hai. Gramin-shahri samajik parampara bade paimane par badli; sanyukt parivar toote; Bharatiya sanskriti ka aakarshan bhi vishwa me badha.

questions.q: In the Indian regional planning framework, the concept of 'Planning Region' primarily emphasizes which principle?
o: Administrative convenience as the principle basis
Functional economic integration and spatial coherence
Climatic homogeneity as the dominant criterion
questions.exp: Bharatiya kshetriy yojana me 'yojana kshetra' karyatmak aarthik ekikaran aur sthaniya sussangatata par zor deta hai. Paanchvi panchvarshiya yojana me kshetriy/upyojanaon ka nirmaan hua – pahadi, janjatiya, sookha-pravan, command kshetra vikas aadi.

questions.q: Identify the correct statement regarding indicators of regional development.
o: Per capita incomes alone adequately reflects balanced regional development
Composite indices combining social, economic and infrastructural indicators provide a more reliable assessment
Climatic uniformity serves as the most reliable development indicator
Population density is the only variable used in development assessment
questions.exp: Samajik, aarthik aur aadharbhoot sanketakon ko milakar bane samagra soochkank (composite indices) adhik vishwasniya moolyankan dete hain. Kshetriy niyojan ka lakshya aarthik-samajik vikas aur kshetriy vishamtaon ko kam karna hai.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding Growth Pole Theory in regional planning.
(A) It suggests development spread uniformly across space.
(B) It emphasizes concentration of economic activities in strategic centres.
(C) It assumes development diffuses outward through spread effects.
(D) It rejects the role of urban centres in regional development.
questions.exp: B aur C sahi; A aur D galat. Vikas samaan nahi failta balki kendra par kendrit hota hai aur prasar prabhaavon se bahar failta hai. Perroux (1955) ne 'vikas dhruv' siddhant diya; Boudeville (1966) ne ise sanshodhit karke 'vikas kendra' siddhant kaha.

questions.q:
Match the following regional imbalance indicators with their primary dimension:
(A) Infrastructure index (B) Literacy rate (C) Per capita industrial output (D) Life expectancy
1. Economic dimension 2. Social dimension 3. Health dimension 4. Physical infrastructure dimension
questions.exp: Avsanrachna soochkank – bhautik avsanrachna; saksharta dar – samajik; prati vyakti audyogik utpadan – aarthik; jeevan pratyasha – swasthya aayam.

questions.q: Which among the following stages came first in the evolution of urban planning in India?
questions.exp: Bharat me shahri niyojan me sabse pehle aupniveshik nagarpalika pahal aayi. 1915 me Madras ke Governor Lord Pentland ne Patrick Geddes ko bulaya; unke sujhavon se Bombay (1898), Mysore (1903), Kolkata (1911), Lucknow (1919), Kanpur (1919), Allahabad me Improvement Trusts bane.

questions.q: Identify the correct principle underlying the concept of 'balanced regional development'.
o: Equal distribution of industries irrespective of resources
Reduction of inter-regional disparities through targeted development policies
Concentration of investment in metropolitan regions
Elimination of rural settlements in favour of urban expansion
questions.exp: Santulit kshetriy vikas ka mool siddhant lakshit neetiyon se antar-kshetriy asamanta ko kam karna hai – har kshetra ki bhaugolik, khanij, manaviya aur aarthik kshamtaon ka aakalan karke vishesh nivesh, buniyadi dhancha aur kaushal vikas.

questions.q: Identify the correct implication of functional regionalization for transport planning.
o: Transport networks should follow administrative boundaries only
Transport planning is unrelated to regional economic linkages
Transport planning must align with flows of goods, services and commuters within nodal regions
questions.exp: Karyatmak kshetriyakaran ka arth hai ki parivahan yojana nodal kshetron ke bheetar vastuon, sevaon aur yatriyon ke pravah ke anuroop honi chahiye. Parivahan logon aur vastuon ko uplabdhta ke sthaan se upyog ke sthaan tak le jaata hai.

questions.q: Identify the correct relationship between Special Economic Zones (SEZs) and export processing in India.
o: SEZs provide duty free enclaves designed to promote export-oriented industries
SEZs primarily restrict foreign investment in industrial production
SEZs function only as agricultural export centres
SEZs operate without infrastructure or fiscal incentives
questions.exp: SEZ niryat-unmukh udyogon ko badhane ke liye shulk-mukt kshetra hain. Bharat ki SEZ neeti April 2000 me aayi (export processing zone model ki prabhavshilta dekhte hue); uddeshya – atirikt aarthik gatividhi, niryat, nivesh, rozgaar aur buniyadi dhancha.

questions.q:
Match the following multipurpose river valley projects with the principal river basin in which they are located:
(A) Hirakud Project (B) Bhakra Nangal Project (C) Nagarjuna Sagar Project (D) Tehri Project
i. Krishna ii. Sutlej iii. Mahanadi iv. Bhagirathi
questions.exp: Hirakud – Mahanadi; Bhakra-Nangal – Sutlej; Nagarjuna Sagar – Krishna; Tehri – Bhagirathi.

questions.q:
Match the following energy resources with their principal geographical concentration:
(A) Wind Energy (B) Solar Energy (C) Hydropower (D) Thermal Coal Energy
i. Western Rajasthan ii. Western Ghats and Himalayan Rivers iii. Gujarat and Tamil Nadu Coast iv. Damodar Valley
questions.exp: Pawan urja – Gujarat aur TN tat; saur urja – paschimi Rajasthan; jalvidyut – paschimi ghat aur Himalayi nadiyan; taapiya koyla – Damodar ghati.

questions.q:
Arrange the following stages in the mechanism of tropical cyclone development over the Bay of Bengal.
(A) Low Pressure formation over warm sea (B) Intensification through latent heat release (C) Development of cyclonic circulation (D) Landfall and Dissipation
questions.exp: Kram: garm samudra par kam dabaav → chakravati parisancharan → gupt ushma chhodne se teevrata → bhooskhalan (landfall) aur apaksay. Ye 30°N–30°S me bante hain; ausat vyas ~640 km; Bangladesh aur Bharat ke poorvi tat par bahut vinashkari.

questions.q: Identify the correct pairing between mineral resource and major producing region in India.
questions.exp: Bauxite – Koraput pathar sahi jodi hai. Odisha me desh ka ~41% bauxite bhandar aur ~73% utpadan (book); Kalahandi-Koraput bauxite patti (~300 km lambi). Sahi: petroleum – Ankleshwar, manganese – Nagpur-Bhandara, lauh – Bailadila.

questions.q: Identify the correct sequence of physiographic divisions of India from north to south based on their structural position.
o: Himalayan Mountains → Northern Plains → Peninsular Plateau → Coastal Plains
Northern Plains → Himalayan Mountains → Coastal Plains → Peninsular Plateau
Peninsular Plateau → Himalayan Mountains → Northern Plains → Coastal Plains
Coastal Plains → Northern Plains → Himalayan Mountains → Peninsular Plateau
questions.exp: Uttar se dakshin kram: Himalaya → Uttari maidan → Prayadweepiya pathar → Tateey maidan. Uttari maidan (Sindhu-Ganga-Brahmaputra, ~7 lakh km²) Himalaya ke dakshin me; pathar ke kinare tateey patti.

questions.q: Identify the correct relationship between urbanization and industrialization in India.
o: Industrial clusters attract labour migration leading to metropolitan expansion
Urban growth occurs independently of industrial development
Urbanization precedes industrial growth in most Indian regions
Industrial regions are always located in rural areas
questions.exp: Audyogik samooh shram pravas ko aakarshit karte hain jisse mahanagaron ka vistaar hota hai. Bharat me kai shahar audyogik kendra ke roop me bade; saath hi shiksha, chikitsa, rozgaar ke liye gramin yuvak shahron ki or aate hain.

questions.q: The Lorenz Curve used in geographical analysis represents spatial inequality through the relationship between which pair of cumulative variables?
o: Cumulative percentage of area and cumulative percentage of rainfall
Cumulative percentage of distance and cumulative percentage of Travel time
Cumulative percentage of settlements and cumulative percentage of transport links
Cumulative percentage of population and cumulative percentage of income/resource
questions.exp: Lorenz vakra jansankhya ke sanchayi pratishat aur aay/sansadhan ke sanchayi pratishat se sthaniya asamanta dikhata hai. Max Lorenz ne isse dhan ki asamanta dikhayi; vakra samaan-vitaran rekha ke jitna paas, asamanta utni kam.

questions.q: The distortion pattern of the Mercator projection becomes extreme toward higher latitudes because which property is preserved in this projection?
questions.exp: Mercator projection me konika anuroopta (conformal – shape sahi) banaye rakhne ke liye ucch akshanshon par kshetrafal bahut fail jata hai. Gerardus Mercator (1569); akshansh rekhaon ke beech doori dhruvon ki or badhti hai; seedhi rekha shuddh disha dikhati hai – nauvahan ke liye upyogi.

questions.q: The reliability of accessibility mapping using network analysis in GIS largely depends on which Integrated dataset structure?
o: Raster elevation grid with spectral bands
Topological vector network with attribute tables
questions.exp: GIS me network vishleshan dwara pahunch-kshamta maanchitran ki vishwasniyata vishesh-tabular ke saath topological vector network par nirbhar karti hai. Vector model dikhata hai ki vastu ki aakriti/sthiti; network vishleshan, shuddh suchi aur topology ke liye upyogi.

questions.q:
Consider the following sequence of operations in digital mapping using remote sensing data.
(A) Geometric correction (B) Image classification (C) Radiometric correction (D) Ground truth verification
questions.exp: Sahi kram: radiometric sudhar → jyamitiya sudhar → chhavi vargikaran → zameeni sachchai satyapan.

questions.q: In cartographic representation of migration flows between cities, which combination of mapping technique and variable scaling is most appropriate?
o: Isopleth mapping with equal interval classes
Flow line map with proportional line thickness
questions.exp: Shahron ke beech pravas pravah dikhane ke liye anupatik motai wali pravah rekha (flow line) maanchitra sabse upyukt hai. Ise 'gatik maanchitra' bhi kehte hain; yatayat, yatri, vahan sankhya dikhane me upyogi.

questions.q: In multiple regression analysis used for regional agricultural productivity studies, the dependent variable usually represents:
questions.exp: Kshetriy krishi utpadakta adhyayan me bahu-pratigaman me aashrit char aam taur par krishi utpadan sanketak hota hai; swatantra char – mrida, sinchai, urvarak, shram, poonji aadi.

questions.q: A chorochromatic map differs fundamentally from a choropleth map because it represents:
o: Qualitative regional categories without statistical ratios
questions.exp: Chorochromatic maanchitra sankhyiki anupaat ke bina gunatmak kshetriy shreniyan (jaise mrida, vanaspati prakaar) rangon se dikhata hai; choropleth prashasanik ikaiyon ke sankhyiki aankde (ghanatva, vriddhi dar) dikhata hai.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Drainage Pattern) with List-II (Area):
(A) Dendritic (B) Centripetal (C) Radial (D) Trellis
i. Caspian Sea ii. Amarkantak iii. Appalachian iv. Amazon
questions.exp: Vrikshakar – Amazon; kendrabhimukh – Caspian sagar; radial (arieey) – Amarkantak; trellis (jaalinuma) – Appalachian.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a Mission of National Action Plan on climate change?
o: National Mission for a Green India
questions.exp: Vanyajeev sanrakshan NAPCC ka mission nahi. NAPCC (30 June 2008) ke 8 mission: saur, urja dakshata, satat aavas, jal, Himalayi paristhitiki tantra, Harit Bharat, satat krishi, jalvayu parivartan par ranneetik gyan.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Remote sensing can be used to study changes in land cover.
Reason (R): Remote sensing does not provide a synoptic view of large area of earth surface.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: (A) sahi, (R) galat. Sudoor samvedan se bhoomi aavaran me badlav ka adhyayan hota hai; ye prithvi ke bade kshetra ka sanyukt (synoptic) drishya deta hai. Shabd ka pehla prayog 1960 ke dashak me.

questions.q: What is the most important cause of coral bleaching?
questions.exp: Praval viranjan ka sabse pramukh kaaran global warming hai – samudri taapmaan badhne se praval ke andar rehne wale shaival (algae) bahar nikal jaate hain, praval ko bhojan nahi milta aur rang ud jata hai.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Contribution) with List-II (Name of Scholar):
(A) First concept of social geography (B) Lieu-Travail Famille (C) Space, Place of Gender (D) The production of Space
i. Henri Lefebvre ii. Camille Vallaux iii. Frederic Le Play iv. D. Massey
questions.exp: Samajik bhugol ki pratham avdharna – Camille Vallaux; Lieu-Travail-Famille – Frederic Le Play; Space, Place and Gender – D. Massey; Production of Space – Henri Lefebvre.

questions.q: Who among the following has included both empirical and genetic classification in the world climate classification?
questions.exp: G.T. Trewartha ne vishwa jalvayu vargikaran me anubhavik aur jananik dono ko shamil kiya. Köppen aur Thornthwaite ke vargikaran anubhavik hain; Trewartha ne Köppen ko sanshodhit kiya, 6 pratham shreni ke jalvayu (A–F) banaye.

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of convergent boundary between an oceanic and continental plate?
questions.exp: Andes parvat mahasagariya (Nazca) aur mahadweepiya (South American) plate ke abhisaran ka udaharan hai. Abhisaran teen prakaar: mahasagariya–mahadweepiya, mahasagariya–mahasagariya, mahadweepiya–mahadweepiya. Mid-Atlantic – apsari; San Andreas – sanrakshi.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Landforms) with List-II (Formation Process):
(A) Drumlin (B) Bajada (C) Inselberg (D) Tombolo
i. Coastal deposition ii. Glacial deposition iii. Fluvial deposition iv. Weathering and wind erosion
questions.exp: Drumlin – himnadiya nikshep; Bajada – nadiya nikshep; Inselberg – apakshay aur pawan apardan; Tombolo – tateey nikshep.

questions.q: Both the poles are shown on which of the following projections?
questions.exp: Sinusoidal projection par dono dhruv bindu ke roop me dikhte hain – poora vishwa dikhaya ja sakta hai. Gall's me dhruv nahi dikhte; polar zenithal me ek golardh; Bonne sanshodhit shankav projection hai (Rigobert Bonne).

questions.q: Who among the following was a key figure in Quantitative Revolution in Geography?
questions.exp: Peter Haggett matratmak kranti ke pramukh vyakti the – pustak 'Locational Analysis in Human Geography' (1965). Bhugol me matratmak kranti 1950 ke dashak me USA me (McCarty, Berry, Garrison) shuru hui, 1960 ke dashak me charam par.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Satellites) with List-II (Applications):
(A) SARAL (B) Cortosat-3 (C) RISAT-2BR-I (D) SCATSAT-I
i. Climate and environment ii. Disaster management iii. Urban Planning iv. Oceanographic studies
questions.exp: SARAL – samudri adhyayan; Cartosat-3 – nagariya niyojan; RISAT-2BR1 – aapda prabandhan; SCATSAT-1 – jalvayu evam paryavaran.

questions.q: If the Standard Deviation (SD) of a data set is 2.83, then what will be its variance?
questions.exp: Prasaran (variance) = maanak vichalan ka varg = (2.83)² ≈ 8.00. Ise maanak vichalan par aadharit dwitiya apkiran ghaat bhi kehte hain.

questions.q:
Select from the following quantitative methods used for demarcation of urban planning regions:
A. Thiessen polygon method B. Graph theory method C. Discriminate analysis D. Nearest neighbour analysis
questions.exp: Nagar niyojan pradeshon ke seemankan me Thiessen bahubhuj, graph siddhant aur vibhedak vishleshan prayog hote hain; nearest neighbour vishleshan basti vitaran ke prakaar (aakaar-antaran) ke liye hai, seemankan ke liye nahi.

questions.q: Which of the following countries produces the most synthetic rubber?
questions.exp: Vishwa me sabse adhik kritrim rubber China banata hai; prakritik rubber me Thailand aage. Rubber ke liye 25–30°C taapmaan aur 150–200 cm varsha uchit; ushna katibandhiya paudha.

questions.q: Who among the following propounded the concept of 'Great Ice Age'?
questions.exp: Vrihad him kaal (Great Ice Age) ki sankalpana Louis Agassiz ne 1840 me di. Him yug me prithvi ka bada bhaag lambe samay tak hime chadar se dhaka raha.

questions.q: Warm and cold-core rings are associated with which oceanic phenomena?
questions.exp: Garm aur thande core rings Gulf Stream se jude hain. Gulf Stream ki khoj Juan Ponce de León ne ki; ye Florida ke paas se uttar-poorv ki or behti hai; 40°N ke paas Labrador ki thandi dhara se milkar Newfoundland ke paas ghana kohra.

questions.q: The development of Perox 'Growth Pole Theory' is basically based on which of the following concept?
questions.exp: Perroux ka vikas dhruv siddhant amoort aarthik kshetra (abstract economic space) par aadharit hai. Koi bada firm jo apne aas-paas ki firmon ko gati deta hai 'utprerak' (propulsive) kehlata hai; Perroux ne 1955 me siddhant diya.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Antarctica is always covered by snow but receives less than 8 cm of annual precipitation.
Reason (R): Speedy winds constantly blow in Antarctica.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi par (R) sahi vyakhya nahi. Antarctica hamesha barf se dhaka par varshik varsha 8 cm se kam – kyunki dakshini dhruv par suryatap kam, thandi hawa me nami kam. Tez hawaayein chalti hain par ye kam varsha ka kaaran nahi. ~98% barf se dhaka; vishwa ka sabse thanda mahadweep.

questions.q: If 'R' is the radius of the reduced earth on a scale, the length of the equator on Mollweide's projection would be:
questions.exp: Mollweide (samkshetra) projection me bhoomadhya rekha ki lambai 4×R×√2 hoti hai. 1805 me Karl Brandan Mollweide ne banaya; 90°E aur 90°W yamottar ek vritt banate hain jiska ardhvyas √2R.

questions.q: Which of the following soils contains the most organic matter?
questions.exp: Histosol me sabse adhik jaivik padarth hota hai – upari 80 cm me jaivik ansh pramukh; adhikansh peat mitti; jalmagnata ke kaaran vighatan kam. Ultisol aardra-ushna kshetron ki; Inceptisol nayi, kam vikasit mitti.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): J.T. Hack proposed the concept of dynamic equilibrium in Geomorphology.
Reason (R): J.T. Hack did not emphasize that landscape achieve a balance between tectonic uplift and denudational process.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: (A) sahi, (R) galat. J.T. Hack ne gatisheel santulan ki avdharna di aur zor diya ki bhudrishya vivartanik utthaan aur anachhadan ke beech santulan prapt karta hai – unke anusaar sthalroop ki aakriti apardan urja aur pratirodh ke santulan par nirbhar.

questions.q: When was the 'smart Cities Mission' launched in India?
questions.exp: Smart Cities Mission 25 June 2015 ko shuru hua – shahron me buniyadi dhancha, svachh-tikau paryavaran aur behtar jeevan star; anya shahron ke liye model.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Fertility rates tend to decline in highly urbanised areas.
Reason (R): Urbanization provides better access to education and employment opportunities especially for women.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Shahron me mahilaon ko shiksha aur rozgaar ke behtar avsar, swasthya suvidhayein, parivar niyojan saadhan milte hain, vivah ki aayu badhti hai – isliye prajanan dar kam.

questions.q: Which type of industry develops due to backward linkage effect?
questions.exp: Paschch sahlagnata (backward linkage) se poorak/sahayak udyog viksit hote hain – ek udyog doosre udyog ko kachcha maal, machinery aadi dene ke liye badhta hai.

questions.q: The weather map of India is prepared on which projection?
questions.exp: Bharat ka mausam maanchitra Mercator projection par banta hai – apvah, samudri dharaein, taapmaan, pawan disha dikhane me upyogi; nauvahan ke liye bhi.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Theories) with List-II (Proponents):
(A) Malthusian theory (B) Demographic transition theory (C) Optimum population theory (D) Cornucopian theory
i. Warren Thompson ii. Julian Simon iii. Thomas Malthus iv. Edwin cannon
questions.exp: Malthus siddhant – Thomas Malthus; jansankhyiki sankraman – Warren Thompson; anukoolatam jansankhya – Edwin Cannan; Cornucopian – Julian Simon.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Oceanic current) with List-II (Location):
(A) Humboldt current (B) Agulhas current (C) Benguela current (D) Antilles current
i. Western Coast of South America ii. Northern Coast of Cuba iii. Western Coast of Africa iv. Eastern Coast of Africa
questions.exp: Humboldt – dakshin America ka paschimi tat; Agulhas – Africa ka poorvi tat; Benguela – Africa ka paschimi tat; Antilles – Cuba ka uttari tat.

questions.q: Which of the following concepts is most closely associated with the spatial organisation of urban systems in regional planning?
questions.exp: Nagar tantra ke sthaniya sangathan se sabse zyada kendriya sthal siddhant juda hai (Christaller 1933, dakshin Germany). Berry ke shabdon me 'kendra sthalon ki avasthiti, aakaar, prakriti aur antaran ka siddhant'. 'Central place' shabd ka pehla prayog Mark Jefferson (1931).

questions.q: Which one of the following is not correct as per Koppen's Scheme of classification of world climate?
questions.exp: An Köppen me ushna marusthal nahi hai – ushna registani BWh hai. Am – ushna mansoon, Af – ushna varsha van, Aw – savanna. Köppen ka vargikaran 1900 (De Candolle 1874 par), sanshodhan 1918, 1931, 1936; paanch mukhya varg.

questions.q:
Arrange the following west flowing rivers in peninsular India from North to South.
I. Sabarmati II. Tapi III. Kali Nadi IV. Bharathappuzha
questions.exp: Uttar se dakshin: Sabarmati → Tapi → Kali nadi → Bharathappuzha. Sabarmati Aravali (Mewar) se nikalkar Khambhat ki khadi me (371 km); Tapi Betul se (724 km); Kali nadi Karnataka me Karwar ke paas Arab sagar me; Bharathappuzha Kerala ki pramukh nadi.

questions.q: Which of the following terms describes the position of a species habitat requirements as well as its functional role?
questions.exp: Ecological niche kisi prajati ki aavas zarooraton aur uski karyatmak bhoomika dono ko batata hai. Do paristhitik tantron ke beech ka sankraman kshetra ecotone; prakritik vaas wo sthan jahan prajati swabhavik roop se paayi jaati hai.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): maximum entropy occurs in the old stage of the hydrological erosion cycle.
Reason (R): In the last stage of the hydrological cycle of erosion, the process of peneplanation is the main effective process.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Jaliya apardan chakra ki vriddhavastha me adhiktam utkram (entropy) hoti hai kyunki is antim avastha me peneplanation pramukh prakriya hoti hai; tarunavastha me entropy kam, kataav adhik.

questions.q: Who among the following propounded the 'Zone Strata Theory'?
questions.exp: Katibandh-sanstar siddhant Griffith Taylor ne 1919 me diya. Manav prajatiyon ki utpatti Madhya Asia me maani gayi, jahan se ve lehron me failin; sabse pehle Negrito; kapal soochkank aur baalon ki banawat ke aadhar par 7 prajatiyan.

questions.q:
Match List-I (Geographers) with List-II (Term used):
(A) Andre Allix (B) R.E. Dickinson (C) Green (D) Smailes
i. City region ii. Urban field iii. Umland iv. Urban Hinterland
questions.exp: Andre Allix – Umland; R.E. Dickinson – City region; Green – Urban hinterland; Smailes – Urban field.

questions.q: Which of the following map projection shows the earth as viewed from space?
questions.exp: Lambkoniya (orthographic) projection prithvi ko antariksh se dekhe jaise dikhata hai – prakash srot anant doori par maana jata hai.

questions.q: How many indicators have been used by Smith to count social happiness?
questions.exp: D.M. Smith ne samajik khushhali ke 7 sanketak liye: aarthik samriddhi, aay vibhajan, nyay aur kanoon, naitik bhavnayein, swatantrata, shiksha-gyan, samajik sthirta.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): Aleutian Islands are a site of volcanic erutions.
Reason (R): Convergent Plate boundaries are site of volcanic eruptions.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: Dono sahi aur (R) sahi vyakhya. Aleutian dweep uttari Prashant me abhisari (vinashi) plate seema par hain. Vishwa ki ~80% jwalamukhi kriya vinashi plate kinaron par aur ~15% rachnatmak kinaron par; Prashant ke kinare 'Ring of Fire'.

questions.q: Shifting cultivation in Malaysia is called:
questions.exp: Malaysia me sthanantarit krishi ko 'Ladang' kehte hain. Shri Lanka – Chena; Madhya America – Milpa; Myanmar – Taungya; Thailand – Tamrai; Brazil – Roca; Poorvottar Bharat – Jhum. Jungle saaf karke kheti, urvarta ghatne par naya sthan.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): The mesosphere is the layer where meteors burn up upon entering the earth's atmosphere.
Reason (R): The mesosphere's has a high concentration of greenhouse gasses.
o: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.exp: (A) sahi, (R) galat. Ulkayein madhyamandal (50–80 km) me ghrishan se jal jaati hain; green house gaison ki ucch sandrata kshobhmandal me hoti hai, madhyamandal me nahi. Madhyamandal me noctilucent badal bante hain.

questions.q: When do the heat Islands develop the most in the cities?
